title: Foundation Digital Handover and Lifecycle Assurance Framework
purpose: Convert the controlled ECP-000001E transmittal into an auditable digital handover with custody, acceptance, KPI and continuous-improvement evidence.
scope: Transmittal ingestion, checksum verification, custody ledger, acceptance gates, maturity assessment, KPI evidence, findings and lifecycle dossier packaging.

requirements.title: ECP-E consumption
requirements.statement: ECP-000001F shall consume and identify a complete ECP-000001E transmittal.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the real vertical consumer chain.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Custody integrity
requirements.statement: The system shall independently verify every transmitted file and record an append-only custody event.
requirements.rationale: Detect corruption and preserve delivery provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Acceptance controls
requirements.statement: The system shall evaluate completeness, integrity, issue and professional-approval acceptance gates.
requirements.rationale: Prevent unsafe or incomplete lifecycle acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Maturity evidence
requirements.statement: The system shall calculate a reproducible five-level capability assessment from explicit gate evidence.
requirements.rationale: Provide measurable progress toward AIAS Level 5.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Sustainable acceleration
requirements.statement: The system shall record baseline, actual, automation and reuse evidence and distinguish estimates from audited measurements.
requirements.rationale: Enforce the constitutional 45 percent target without unsupported claims.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Lifecycle dossier
requirements.statement: The system shall generate a versioned machine-readable dossier, findings register and checksum-protected release archive.
requirements.rationale: Create a tangible reusable handover asset.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
